name: Philologus
title: Christian in Rome
summary: Philologus was a Christian in Rome whom Paul greeted in his letter to the Romans. His name means 'one who loves words' or 'scholar', and he is mentioned together with Julia and other believers in a house church in Rome.

keyEvents.title: Greeting from Paul
keyEvents.description: Paul sends greetings to Philologus along with Julia, Nereus and his sister, Olympas, and all the holy ones among them, indicating that they belonged to a house church in Rome.
